messages.1000004: What can I do for you?
messages.1000005:
Cardinal Barshival,
Are you going to talk to this stranger?
messages.1000006:
Why not?
Except for the dirty appearance,
the stranger seems ok.
messages.1000007:
Are you kidding?
A report from Bishop Berini
in Antalusia?
messages.1000009:
Let's see here...
It's about the sacred relics.
messages.1000010:
Judging from the story,
you returned two of the sacred relics.
messages.1000012:
The report seems authentic.
I appreciate your efforts. Here's a token of my gratitude.
messages.1000013: We're investigating the thefts right now.
messages.1000014:
Would you be interested in
being my right-hand warrior?
messages.1000015:
Please let me know if anything goes wrong,
Cardinal Barshival.
messages.1000016:
Well,
I need you to protect me.
messages.1000019:
The report from Bishop Berini
said that you are skillful.
messages.1000021:
Looks like you're an independent warrior,
and you seem to be a trustworthy person,
judging from the fact that you took back
the sacred relics.
messages.1000022:
We're looking for a person like you.
The atmosphere around the Noil Religious sect
has been uneasy lately.
messages.1000023: That's why I always guard Cardinal Barshival.
messages.1000024:
Let me share something else with you...
This is just between us, all right?
messages.1000025:
If you tell anyone this information,
I'll kill you.
messages.1000028:
Anyways... The other day, I had the Elf Rangers
go after the sacred relics.
messages.1000029:
However, they suddenly disappeared,
and we found them all dead a bit later.
messages.1000030:
They were skilled enough to have beaten the Ancient Dragon
if they wanted to. So I'm thinking it wasn't
human beings or a group of demons that killed them.
messages.1000031: What I'd like you to do is look into this.
messages.1000032:
I'll tell the high-ranking people in this town about you,
so you don't look conspicuous.
messages.1000035:
Oh, good timing.
Just before you came,
Archbishop Jurg sent a report.
messages.1000036:
He has located the sacred relic, Angel's Nail.
It's in a Dragon Cave in the Forest of Ilbarna,
west of Losmans South.
messages.1000037:
Since the Dragons are sleeping, it shouldn't much of a problem
to retrieve it. I'd like you to go there and get it. Since you beat
the Ancient Dragon, you should be okay even if you wake them.
messages.1000038: I'd go if I didn't already have an assignment.
messages.1000039: I expect you to do well.
messages.1000040: I expect you to do well.
messages.1000041:
Whoa!
The Angel's Nail.
You did it!
messages.1000044:
According to Archbishop Jurg's report,
they should've been dormant but...
messages.1000045:
Anyway, you killed them, right?
You are a mighty soldier to have beaten these as
well as the Ancient Dragon.
messages.1000047:
This is your reward.
I appreciate the good work.
messages.1000048: I expect nothing but good things from you.
messages.1000049:
Did you say that Archbishop Jurg is
investigating the ruins at the Hill of Heaven?
messages.1000051:
Something's not right.
Can you go there and see what what's going on?
messages.1000052:
With my letter, you can go inside the ruins.
The ruins are on the Hill of Heaven, north of the Forest of Ilbarna.
messages.1000053:
I'm thinking that...
The Ancient Ruins are...
messages.1000054:
Yes, that's right. Inside the ruins, you cannot
warp anywhere due to some sort of magic power
disabling the transport system.
Be careful.
messages.1000056:
Someone is studying the ancient technologies
in the Ancient Ruins!?
messages.1000057: And that traitor Gawl was there?
messages.1000062:
Poison!?
Did Archbishop Jurg poison
that wine?!
messages.1000064:
You!
Find an antidote for him!
I'll try to slow the effect.
messages.1000065:
You can find an all-purpose antidote in Ponse,
the village of dwarves. It's southeast of here!
messages.1000066:
Ponse is east of the Moldona Peninsula
that crosses South Losmans.
I'm counting on you!
messages.1000073:
Well...
I may... manage to... survive.
messages.1000074:
Phew...
I really appreciate your help this time.
messages.1000075:
I wonder if Archbishop Jurg had a
hand in this...
messages.1000076:
Here's a reward.
I can't tell you how grateful I am.
messages.1000078:
What?
A servant of Archbishop Jurg said that?
messages.1000080:
This situation is getting out of hand.
We need to think carefully about our next move.
messages.1000083:
Yes...
Please keep this story a secret.
messages.1000085:
A while ago, his son and I were candidates
for cardinal.
messages.1000086:
I was chosen because I could get support
from both the elves and humans
due to my mixed blood.
messages.1000087:
Although Jurg was disappointed at the time,
he accepted the result.
messages.1000090:
Soon after Barshival here became cardinal,
the demons became active, and the army was instructed
to engage them.
messages.1000091: The soldiers soon became exhausted from the frequent battles.
messages.1000093:
One day, when Archbishop Jurg's son led a unit of the army
on an attack mission, the Elf Rangers weren't there to help them
because of some sort of miscommunication.
messages.1000094: As a result, the enemy annihilated the unit and Jurg's son was killed.
messages.1000095:
Somebody caught what Archbishop Jurg said
when he heard about his son...
messages.1000096:
He said that the Elf Rangers abandoned his son on purpose,
and it was a plot concoted by Cardinal Barshival.
messages.1000097:
Of course, it's not true at all.
It was due to a lack of communication and the fact that
the soldiers were totally exhausted.
messages.1000098:
Since then, Archbishop Jurg has devoted his studies to the sacred
relics. Personally, he's changed a lot since then as well.
messages.1000099:
He might try to get revenge on the Noil religion and I
by using some learned power from the Ancient World.
messages.1000100: By the way, this is a reward for your hard work.
messages.1000101:
Information we've received claims that Archbishop Jurg has locked
himself up at the Remains of the Dead in Alteria.
Alteria is far west of here.
messages.1000102:
We're looking for collaborators of Archbishop Jurg
within our group right now, but it will take time to get results.
messages.1000103:
So, I would like you to head for
the Remains of the Dead.
messages.1000104:
To get to Alteria, you need to go through the Hill of Heaven
in the east then pass Saint Sena's Shrine after taking the Road of
Atonement. I'll contact someone at Sena's shrine.
messages.1000105:
Somebody told me that Archbishop Jurg has control of a dark power of
the Ancient World. We're counting on you to stop him.
messages.1000109:
You did a great job.
Too bad about Archbishop Jurg though...
messages.1000110:
Here's 100,000 in gold and
the right to use Giant Warehouse IV in appreciation.
messages.1000111:
You're a savior of the Noil religion.
I'll give you permission
to enter all the ruins under Noil control.
messages.1000113:
Yes.
There still might be something helpful
in the ruins.
messages.1000114: You may do whatever you wish.
messages.1000116:
I've heard that there were some gold and silver orbs
in some of the ruins.
messages.1000118: I would like to ask one thing.
messages.1000119:
Have you ever heard of the dangerous area that spreads to the
northwest of Calado? I believe that no one can enter that area now.
messages.1000120:
We closed the area
because the demons living there have been getting stronger.
A group researching the area, however, gave us information
about the sacred relics of Altecia.
messages.1000121:
We think Angel's Memory, a sacred relic of the White Angel Altecia,
can be found at the Ancient Institute located in the Forest of Dragon.
To get there, you should pass through Labyrinth of the Lake
to the west of the Town of Calado. Could you return the relic to me?
messages.1000122:
The dangerous area near West Calado
is under the control of the magic of Hiperion.
messages.1000123:
Please be careful.
Stronger demons inhabit that area.
messages.1000125:
The sacred relic of Altecia!
Thank you! And here is the reward you're
probably expecting.
messages.1000128:
All right...
I'll tell you a little about her.
messages.1000129:
You probably know that
we, the Noil, worship the White Angel Altecia.
messages.1000130:
Noilism teaches that
Altecia is an angel
who sealed the Devil Dignosis in Hiperion.
messages.1000131:
When she began the Noil religion,
she taught two things:
how to survive in this polluted world and
techniques to defeat the Devil Dignosis should he arise again.
messages.1000132:
Of course, we kept the lessons
and tried to prevent our world from being polluted by
using the Ancient World's technology, so we dug into the ruins.
messages.1000133:
One day, we found a girl sleeping in a tube container
filled with liquid in one of the ruins.
We named her Sena.
messages.1000134:
You're wondering what her relationship is to Altecia,
aren't you?
messages.1000135:
Well, there was a message
written on her container.
messages.1000136:
"Here lies the reincarnation of Altecia,
set to awake at the end of this world."
messages.1000137:
And suddenly, to our surprise, she awoke.
She had amnesia and acted and responded like any other girl.
messages.1000138:
The steady rise of the demons over the previous two years must've
led to her awakening. It was also a safe bet that Dignosis was back
if she had risen from her sleep.
messages.1000139:
That's why we're digging up the sacred relics of Altecia.
We're preparing to fight him.
messages.1000140: Yes, I have something I need to ask of you.
messages.1000141:
Can you deliver the collected sacred relics
to Saint Sena?
messages.1000142:
She will seem just like any other girl,
but remember her ties with Altecia.
messages.1000145:
Are you surprised that Saint Sena is
the reincarnation of Altecia?
messages.1000146:
From now on,
I would like you to work for Saint Sena,
or, Altecia's order.
messages.1000147:
You can reach Berini Village in the west of the Labyrinth of the Lake
after passing West Calado to the west.
messages.1000148:
The fate of this world is in your hands.
We are depending on you.
messages.1000154:
Thanks for showing me!
Hey, I want to tell you something.
messages.1000155: We've defeated various demons so far.
messages.1000156:
But there are some demons with powers beyond that which we can handle
so the best we could do was to isolate them.
messages.1000157:
If you would like to train yourself against stronger enemies,
you should go to where they are contained.
messages.1000158: You'll find the unknown place at the Warp Point.
messages.1000160: Oh my! You killed the demons we feared engaging?
messages.1000161:
There isn't a demon in this world that can defeat you,
is there?
messages.1000162:
You're making demons an endangered species in this world.
Way to go!
messages.1000163:
Since you're a hired warrior and probably like substantial rewards,
I'll give you access to the Giant Warehouse X.
messages.1000164:
I hope you continue to use your power
for the good of mankind.
messages.1000165:
Shall I trade with you?
Or shall I repair and judge your items?
 
 ・~Buy Armaments         ~
 ・~Buy Equipment         ~
 ・~Identify Items        ~
 ・~Repair Items          ~
                                 ~QUIT~
messages.1000166:
・~Arms               %9d Gold~
 ・~Head Armor         %9d Gold~
 ・~Body Armor         %9d Gold~
 ・~Shield             %9d Gold~
 ・~Leg Armor          %9d Gold~
 ・~All Equipped Items %9d Gold~
 ・~Non-Equipped Items %9d Gold~
                           ~QUIT~
messages.1000169:
To identify your item, it costs %d in Gold.  OK?
 
                                 ~YES~  ~NO~
messages.1000170: You don't have anything that's unknown.
messages.1000171:
I'm Egel.
I thought I'd find others like me in Losmans
because this town has a castle.
messages.1000172:
But I guess I was wrong.
Nothing but high-class snobs here...
messages.1000173: I'm the holy spirit witch, Chelsea.
messages.1000174:
I heard that Losmans was a busy town, but I don't see many people...
I wonder if it's because of the last attack.
I miss seeing lots of people.
messages.1000176:
Holy spirits!
Heal the evil wounds!
messages.1000179:
My duty is
to protect Cardinal Barshival.
messages.1000183:
Some bishops are hiding away in a tower in Golas Desert.
It's related to the event involving Archbishop Jurg.
messages.1000184:
They may not cause any harm, but
we shouldn't leave them alone.
messages.1000185:
They might disperse
if we can defeat all the phantoms protecting them in the tower.
messages.1000186:
The tragedy involving Jurg's son was a misunderstanding.
We are not going to punish them,
so could you try and persuade them to stop seeking revenge?
messages.1000187:
You can get to the tower from the Warp Rune.
I'm counting on you.
messages.1000189: Now let's all breathe a sigh of relief.
messages.1000190:
I tell you what.
I'll give you some important information.
messages.1000191:
In this world, there are nine kinds of Collector's Items.
It seems hard to collect them all
because they are expensive and can vanish
when enemies drop them.
messages.1000192:
Cardianal Barshival has been very interested in the Collector's Items
for a long time now.
messages.1000193:
Who are you?
I'm Sir Gregorious the Mighty.
Are you talking to me?
messages.1000194:
A hired warrior?
This is not a place for hired warriors.
messages.1000195:
Some of the people around here might call you a wage-snatch
if you don't work hard.
messages.1000196:
Me? I'm fine.
Why? Because I'm mighty and
my existence is valuable. They need me.
messages.1000197:
You should go back to
your little assignments.
messages.1000198:
What do you know about Archbishop Jurg!?
You're kidding!
messages.1000200:
Hello,
I'm Sir Rimneas.
Who are you?
messages.1000201:
Oh, the hired warrior.
The last attack was hard, wasn't it?
I appreciate the work you've done.
messages.1000202:
I may be an aristocrat but I carry myself
like anyone else.
messages.1000203:
Aristocracy is no better than thievery. We receive
money with little effort. At least some thieves work hard.
messages.1000204: Why most aristocrats feel superior to others is beyond me.
messages.1000205:
Sir Gregorious here is the worst.
Don't mind him.
messages.1000207:
Oh, you're the hired warrior
whom Cardinal Barshival mentioned.
messages.1000208:
You heard about the elf rangers, right?
I'm not sure what happened,
but a friend of mine is a saint knight.
messages.1000209:
He may know something about it that others
don't.
messages.1000210:
His name is Licarn.
He owns a tower
in South Losmans.
messages.1000211:
I'll contact him,
so you should go see him sometime.
messages.1000215:
He's an aristocrat
supported by Archbishop Jurg.
messages.1000217:
My name is Wallace.
I'm a servant and butler for Archbishop Jurg.
messages.1000222:
Where the master can be found is none
of your business, don't you think?
messages.1000223:
All right, OK. The master is studying at the Hill of Heaven.
He's researching the sacred relics.
messages.1000226:
What?! ...
You want to know the truth?! You
really want to know the truth? Well...
messages.1000227:
We did it all!
The attack on the town of Losmans,
the annihilation of the Elf Rangers,
the theft of the sacred relics...
messages.1000229:
Everything comes down to the Noils
and Cardinal Barshival!
messages.1000230:
And now that I've told you all that we've done,
there's still really nothing you can do about it.
messages.1000231:
The only mistake was that you were not
killed in the Dragon Cave.
messages.1000232:
Archbishop Jurg is in excellent position.
Surely we've won!
messages.1000233:
All that is left to do is to see to it that
Cardinal Barshival is poisoned and my mission will
be complete. I don't care if I am caught and executed.
messages.1000236:
Dead?! It can't be! NO!
I don't believe it...
messages.1000237: May I ask who you are?
messages.1000238:
Are you a hired warrior?
I'm the wife of the owner of this mansion.
Call me Mrs. Morris.
messages.1000239:
You're a hired warrior, right?
May I ask you something of you?
messages.1000240:
My hobby is dressmaking, but
I cannot find good fabric here.
messages.1000241:
If you don't mind, would you please find for me
some white cloth, red thread, and a silver needle?
messages.1000242:
If you go to other towns,
I believe you can buy them easily.
messages.1000244: Oh, you bought them for me.
messages.1000245:
I appreciate your help.
Please accept this in return.
messages.1000246: I can finally make a new dress.
messages.1000248:
Ah, you're the hired warrior.
I'd like to tell you something.
messages.1000249:
I've heard that a very rare medicine
can be found at Wham Ruins in the Mesrald Burial Grounds.
messages.1000251:
According to a rumor,
the Silver Orb, a key to the gate of Hiperion,
is in The Ruins of Lukuna in Golas Desert.
messages.1000252:
But I wonder, who would venture to Hiperion
by choice?
messages.1000254:
Oh, it's you.
I've heard of you. I was impressed by the stories.
messages.1000255:
I'll tell you something...
Somebody said that the Gold Orb can be found in The Ruins of Zeres
on Lunafuld Beach.
messages.1000257: I'd like to eat some Smart Oranges...
messages.1000258: They are growing on the Road of Atonement.
messages.1000260:
If I had a Mandragora...
Mmm...
messages.1000262:
A Mandragora!
Where did you get that? Well, no big deal.
messages.1000263:
If you give that to me,
I'll give you something rare.
messages.1000264:
I am a Wizard Instructor. Welcome to my class.
My training is for people who want to change professions.
messages.1000265:
You're not qualified enough yet
for training.
messages.1000266: Come again after gaining more experience.
messages.1000267:
All right.
Looks like you're well trained.
messages.1000268: It should be okay for you to change professions.
messages.1000269:
Everybody needs to donate 100,000 in gold to the Noil cause
in order to receive training.
messages.1000270:
What type of profession interests you?
       ~Warrior~
       ~Hunter~
       ~Wizard~
 
       ~QUIT~
messages.1000274:
OK.
Let me start your training.
messages.1000278:
You may change professions now
by pushing the Change of Job button on the Status screen.
